name: Stds
overview: Scripture clearly teaches that moral purity and faithfulness in marriage are essential to the believer’s walk with God. Ephesians 5:3 exhorts Christians to avoid fornication and all forms of uncleanness, emphasizing that such behavior is not fitting for saints. Hebrews 13:4 upholds the honor of marriage and warns that God will judge those who engage in sexual immorality such as whoring and adultery. Galatians 6:7 reminds us that God’s justice is certain: individuals will reap the consequences of their actions, underscoring the seriousness of living in holiness.
